title: phaseolus vulgaris var. subochraceus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. subochraceus, commonly known as a variety of the common bean, is a plant species known for its unique characteristics and potential health benefits. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive health due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. subochraceus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to have potential therapeutic applications, including anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties.
